question: Does scalable one-update relevance KMeans retain OI's nonlinear ranking utility while becoming competitive with LP-FULL on linear ranking and runtime?

methods.A: direct current unrefined OverlapIndex parity control
methods.B: direct current balanced-median refined OverlapIndex parity control
methods.S: scalable one-update relevance-weighted KMeans with 64 MiB tile budget and no prototype refinement
methods.LP-FULL: five-fold full linear probe with the archived Normalizer plus LogisticRegression recipe

execution.fold_seed: panel_seed + fold for A/B/S; panel_seed for LP-FULL
execution.order: deterministic cyclic rotation over A/B/S/LP-FULL; exactly balanced because 600 is divisible by 4
execution.warmup: one excluded exact structural repeat per method on its first frozen panel
execution.checkpoint: one complete paired four-method panel written atomically
execution.resume: identity-locked; no mixing across protocol, code, cache, panel, or subset hashes

statistics.selection_ties: average downstream outcome across selector scores equal within atol=1e-12
statistics.rank_auc: normalized trapezoid AUC of per-budget Spearman over budgets 64,68,72,80

gates.clean_linear_vs_probe: upper95 paired regret difference S minus LP-FULL <= 1.0 accuracy point
gates.nuisance_linear_vs_probe: upper95 paired regret difference S minus LP-FULL <= 1.0 accuracy point
gates.nonlinear_vs_probe: for each quadratic, knn, rbf on nonlinearity_full, upper95 paired regret difference S minus LP-FULL <= 1.0 point
gates.nonlinear_retention: for each quadratic, knn, rbf on nonlinearity_full, upper95 paired regret difference S minus B <= 1.0 point
gates.nonlinear_superiority_claim: descriptive established only for a head when S-minus-LP regret upper95 < 0; not required for viability
gates.runtime: within each arm, median paired S/LP-FULL wall ratio <= 1.0 and replicate-block upper95 <= 1.10
gates.parity: A, B, and LP-FULL scores exactly equal all archived replay controls
gates.determinism: clock-free warmup and measured signatures exactly equal for all methods

claim_scope: Food-101 retrospective development evidence under the frozen class-balanced selector sampling protocol; no untouched confirmation or public-product claim
